Native window, application menu and page title said Moos. Finder displayed the Moos name and icon. The app's icon bytes matched the existing Moos icon.
The empty workbench displayed the center M, and the bottom-left Settings button directly opened Settings with Models and Plugins.
The default workspace was created under the probe's app data. The loopback listener exited after normal application quit.
The app reopened with the browser proxy denying external requests and exempting loopback. The actual network interface stayed enabled.

On the isolated verification profile, the original maid-atelier package activated. The Moos PI fixture displayed write and bash outcomes in the skinned conversation and result.txt bytes matched branded_shell_ok plus newline.
